name: Ancestral Knowledge (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Ancestors Patron

The witch spends 1 minute in quiet meditation, communing with her familiar by holding it in both hands, and she hears the words of those who came before her. After communing, she gains a circumstance bonus to any one Knowledge skill check equal to her Intelligence modifier. This bonus lasts for 1 minute or until it is used.
